snippet.title: 12 Angry Tests - Official Trailer [HD]
snippet.description:
Steam Workshop Download: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=68540935
Please post comments on the download page. I am not affiliated with the creation or administration of these maps.

Get ready for fun and excitement! This map pack consists of 6 maps with 2 tests/map. Every map has a different theme and puzzle element. There will be many hazards and many surprises. And you will have to face the most evil villain of all!

TWP Downloads: http://forums.thinkingwithportals.com/downloads.php?view=detail&df_id=1441
TWP Forum: http://forums.thinkingwithportals.com/topic5230.html

Trailer created by iWork925 by request of author with permission. Myself nor CaretCaret are affiliated with Valve. Valve, and Portal are trademarks and/or registered trademarks of Valve Corporation.



===AUDIO===

The 'song' doesnt have a name. The music is something I made in fruity loops especially for the trailer.

All that remains of that song is the music heard in the trailer. I give you permission to rip the music from the trailer using a website like youtube-mp3 dot org. Also feel free to use it however you want.
